description: Ground truth for the synthetic Claude Code session in session.jsonl. The session has designed problems and one designed strength. Lens bands are wide on purpose: a lens is expected to land inside its band, not on an exact number. An issue counts as mentioned when the report text contains one of its keywords (case-insensitive). A keyword written as an object with `phrase` and `with` counts only in a sentence that also holds a word starting with one of the `with` entries; this keeps a phrase such as 'one at a time' from matching a sentence about the person's prompts. The runner removes session.jsonl and this file from the work dir, so the reviewed project has no answer key and no instruction file (CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md).

prompt_craft.why: Vague first prompt and two angry corrections, but one precise, well-scoped follow-up.

workflow_efficiency.why: Two wrong edits, two correction loops, and four runs of the same failing test command.

agentic_leverage.why: Three files read one by one instead of one search; no search tool, no subagent.

error_recovery.why: Corrections named the area but not the error, so recovery took several turns; the same failing command was repeated.

context_instruction.why: No CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md in the project, no memory, and no context given at the start.

overall.why: Mostly problems, with one good moment.

keywords: do not change any other file
